stem: Yash wants to cover a 3-by-5 grid of unit squares with 2-by-1 tiles. Tiles must not overlap and must not leave gaps.

parts.text: Can the grid be tiled completely?

options.text: Only if the tiles may overlap

parts.text: Give one reason for your choice.

part_answers.answer: The grid has 15 unit squares, an odd number, and each 2-by-1 tile covers 2 squares, so a complete tiling is impossible.

teacher.key_rationale: 3×5 = 15 is odd; each tile covers 2 squares, so area parity blocks a tiling. Overlap is not allowed by the stem.
